reviews.title: New update sucks
reviews.text: I have been a premium subscriber for over eight years and have well over 1300 rounds recorded. This new update that you’ve done for scorekeeping is the worst app on the market now. I will be canceling my subscription on March 5, 2027 when the next renewal comes up.

reviews.title: Slow to calculate yardage
reviews.text: The app is taking a long time to calculate my yardage. It holds onto my old yardage, even though I’ve been at the new spot for my Ball for length of time.

reviews.title: Updated software
reviews.text: I just down loaded the new update and now it won’t compute yardage for holes. Terrible update. I’ll have to use another app.

reviews.title: Scam 🚨 alert
reviews.text: I advise against purchasing because last year, I had to canceled multiple times. Than the persistent calls from their call center staff trying to add features to the app. I canceled my subscription, which I consider a scam, over a year ago. However, today I added funds to my wallet and was still charged by them. How is that possible if I never authorized an in-app purchase? Stay clear of this.

reviews.title: Used to love it
reviews.text: Had to upgrade my subscription. Lost 100 previous rounds and could no longer input details for each hole. And that was for a premium subscription! What happened??

reviews.title: Careful on the 13th hole
reviews.text: This app kills your watch battery. I was happy until the 13th hole and the app drained my Apple Watch battery. I had a great last 25 holes but I couldn’t tell my wife if was not going to be home anytime soon. Maybe this was not a bad thing?

reviews.title: Doesn’t save
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years and used to love it. Be careful because they will  overcharged you on a subscription renewal more than what they charge for new people to subscribe. And you can’t save a round. It keeps telling me that it won’t save. And I have on multiple times. Try to get somebody to help out with it and I get no response from them. Used to love this app but it’s ridiculous that over the last year and a half, you can’t save anything. And then you get overcharged for it anyway.

reviews.title: Newest version spams you to upgrade
reviews.text:
One of my favorite things about SwingU (and why I’ve subscribed in the past) is because it’s quality and accessibility, offering a few more things for free than competitors. The latest update puts nearly everything behind a paywall and has no clear differences between options. Go to enter your score, get an add to upgrade. Tap on scoring options you’re used to tracking, like tee shot left/right, get an add to upgrade. How many times do I need to see an add DURING A ROUND TO UPGRADE?  Around 20 times my last round.  Sorry SwingU, I just bought a rangefinder.

Edit: I ended up giving and paying for a heavily discounted upgrade.  The elevations are listed are never correct, and it’s not even close.  Like consistently tells you the hole is uphill when it’s downhill wrong.  On top of that, they won’t give me a refund because I waited too long to ask. Do yourself a favor and try another app.

reviews.title: Gps terrible now
reviews.text: After having the app for several years this year the gps is extremely slow to catch up and gives the wrong yardage for several seconds most times i have to background the app and open it to fix it, just paid for renewal in April and they refused to refund the renewal since I bought The Grint which is cheaper and a far superior app

reviews.title: Too long to process
reviews.text: It takes too long to process and get the distance.

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: Won’t let me play the course I want and will auto go a course

reviews.title: Cancelling the app
reviews.text: When I could walk I considered this as a potential good option as an app… now I can barely walk 50 yards… I canceled the app just as I was being billed… I live on my fixed retirement income and I cannot walk and I need the money for medications and other life essentials.  Please cancel my subscription and return my money.  Sincerely, Allen Ralston

reviews.title: Inconsistent play distances.
reviews.text: Distances, play distances, wind speed didn’t match up.

reviews.title: Auto renew
reviews.text: This isn’t listed in subscriptions but yet automatically renewed, unacceptable

reviews.title: New is not better
reviews.text: I absolutely hate the new layout. I spend more time fruitlessly tapping the tiny selection boxes. You tried to cram everything onto one page and it sucks.

reviews.title: Not intuitive / better apps
reviews.text: Have used several golf apps. Downloaded this on a course when my main one wasn’t working well and everyone was having issues with it. It was complicated to even start and pointless once set to the course on how to use it. Tried for 15 minutes to get it to work, with no luck. Much better apps out there that work well/are easy to use.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: Have you Swing U for 15 years and I don’t know what happened this year but on the three courses I played so far multiple holes have elevations that are way off and hence my club recommendation is way off and if I’m not paying attention, I’ll use the wrong club. I don’t ever remember having this problem in the past but it’s totally screwed up now and not worth the 100 bucks. I just paid for it.  How do I get a refund?

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: Very misleading app tells you that it’s free until you download it and then it’s telling you that it’s a $99 a year subscription. Why tell people it’s free when it’s not

reviews.title: Apple Watch issues
reviews.text: Great when it works, but you’ll spend most of your time fighting with the app to get it to work on your Apple watch.  No cloud storage so if you have to uninstall the app, you have  to re-enter all your information.

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: They get your money with false promises. Don't get this app. Waste of money.

reviews.title: Cowboy capt Ron
reviews.text:
Not overly impressed 
Very poor how to use instructions. 
Can’t get the strokes to close sometimes. 
It is ruff around the edges   That is to say it doesn’t flow very well from stroke to stroke. 
The instructions suck too general. No tutorial for you to practice with. On the course it is play golf not play with an app on your phone. 
Scotty Shefler doesn’t use it so why should I waste my time TRYING to use it during a round.

reviews.title: Awful.
reviews.text: Could not start the round each hole had to just guess where I was in relation to key features.  2nd time trying it and still no good

reviews.title: Handicap broken
reviews.text: Reported an issue with the handicap defaulting to 0 on the scorecard. Support responded quickly but 3 days later it’s still not fixed.

app.name: SwingU Golf GPS by Golf Genius
